title: Overview | Mitchell Farm | Neighborhood in Killeen, TX
description:
Introducing Mitchell Farm! This vibrant community offers a variety of craftsman style homes with multiple floor plans to choose from and key standard features like shaker style cabinets, granite countertops, vinyl plank flooring and stainless kitchen appliances. This community is located off HWY 201/Clear Creek Rd, near Killeen Regional Airport, Texas A&M Central Texas, and Ft. Cavazos. With easy access to I 14 and 195, residents will enjoy easy access to shopping, restaurants, and entertainment.
